metaDescription: Take our 2-minute physician survey. Measure your administrative overload and see how DocNote can save time on clinical documentation.
h1: How heavy is your administrative load?
intro: A short physician survey about your documentation workload. See where you stand compared with other doctors, then discover how much time you could reclaim.
profileSub: A few details to personalise your comparison. Answers stay confidential.
errAll: Please answer all questions to continue.
methodQ: What is your usual method for writing your consultation reports?
methodPaper: Paper notes, then typed into the computer after the consultation
methodComputer: Notes taken directly on the computer during the consultation
timeQ: How much time do you spend, per consultation, writing the administrative report?
impactQ: How much does administrative work affect your work (stress, mental load)?
overtimeQ: Overtime due to administrative work (per week)
contactTitle: Where should we send your results?
contactSub: We're preparing your personalised index and a comparison with other physicians.
errContact: Please fill in all fields with a valid email and phone number.
privacy: Your data stays confidential and is never sold. Swiss hosting, compliant with nFADP / GDPR.
demoTitle: What if this report wrote itself?
demoPrefix: See in the video how DocNote writes a complete
demoSuffix: report from a simple voice dictation.
accountSub: Language, specialty and phone are pre-filled. Start in one click.
percentileTpl: You are more overloaded than {pct}% of the physicians surveyed so far.
timeCaptionTpl: You spend {min} min on it, more than {pct}% of physicians.
